Introducing Multi-Accounts: One Login, Multiple Truss Accounts


Shared by Customer support • September 30, 2026


Hi there,


**Multi-accounts are rolling out now.**


Profit, payroll, materials, or however you split it. Every account under one Truss login.


[Set up your accounts →](https://app.trusspayments.com/dashboard/accounts)


- **Add accounts.** Open extra Truss deposit accounts when you need them.
- **Set a primary.** Choose the account you use most.
- **Move money between them.** Transfer between your Truss accounts.
- **Pick the account at checkout.** Choose which account pays, in checkout and in bill pay.


Profit money stays profit money.


Want to see the feature live? Join the Lunchtime Live October 2nd at 11:15am PST.


[Watch the live](https://www.youtube.com/live/P6ZT76RWtek?si=OQuKwHr4r1cpj1EH)
